programs.title: Private Islands
programs.desc: In Fiji, Wakaya Island is a place where luxury and privacy are first and foremost and where visitors feel right at home as soon as their toes hit the sand.

programs.title: Behind the Gates
programs.desc: Two luxury estates located in Orange County. The first in Dana Point has both a golf course and magnificent ocean views. The second is a $50 million dollar company with everything money could buy.

programs.title: Travel Thru History
programs.desc: We head up the steps of the ancient high temple at Lamanai. Then we take a city tour of the main tourist destination, Belize City. We learn about Belize's colonial roots at the Belize City History Museum and dive the amazing Blue Hole.

programs.title: 5 Star Getaways
programs.desc: A visit to the Mayan Riviera, in the Caribbean Sea; several hotels in the area offer a typical Mexican cultural and culinary experience in addition to the expedition to discover the historical wonders that Mexico has to offer.

programs.title: Facing Waves
programs.desc: The Missinipe Whitewater Festival in Saskatchewan, Canada; a canoe trip on the Churchill River.

programs.title: Dream Purchase
programs.desc: Peter seeks a grand piano worthy of his musical passion. From vintage beauties to modern masterpieces, he searches for the instrument that inspires him to play.
